tagline.zh: 接手陌生项目的第一分钟
tagline.en: Your first minute in an unfamiliar repo

story.zh: 你刚入职，同事丢给你一个仓库就去开会了。没有文档，没有交接，只有一个终端。
story.en: It's your first day. A teammate hands you a repo and disappears into a meeting. No docs, no handover, just a terminal.

goal.zh: 不读一行代码，让 Qoder 帮你搞懂这个项目。
goal.en: Understand the project without reading a single line yourself.

openingPrompt.zh: 用三句话告诉我这个项目是做什么的
openingPrompt.en: Tell me what this project does in three sentences

hint.zh: 第一句提示词已经输进右边的终端了，按回车发送，看 Qoder 都翻了哪些文件。
hint.en: The first prompt is already typed into the terminal on the right. Press Enter, then watch which files Qoder opens.

prompt.zh: 代码里藏了一个周五彩蛋，是什么？
prompt.en: There is a Friday easter egg hidden in the code. What is it?

prompt.zh: 用 ASCII 画一张这个项目的模块关系图
prompt.en: Draw an ASCII diagram of how the modules relate
